question.text: The Sponsor/Manager of a Category III AIF must satisfy which regulatory standard?

answer.text: Fit and proper person per Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008

explanation.text: The Logic: Sponsor and Manager must satisfy 'fit and proper person' criteria per Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008. The Trap: Scrutiny exists; CA/citizenship are not mandated.
